source_text: fromian; p. ode, ade; pp. od, ad To profit, avail; pr&o-long;desse, v&a-short;l&e-long;re :-- Ðætte seó hálwende onsægednes to écre alýsnesse swíþrade and fromade ge líchoman ge sáwle quia sacr&i-short;f&i-short;cium s&a-short;l&u-long;t&a-long;re ad redempti&o-long;nem v&a-short;l&e-long;ret et an&i-short;mæ et corp&o-short;ris semp&i-short;ternam, Bd. 4, 22; S. 592, 28. v. fremian.
